label: opencode
notes: Primary source: GET /console/api/usage/rows?range=all&pageSize=100&cursor=… from the signed-in Console tab (session cookie + x-org-id header). One record per inference request, cursor-paginated; range=all covers full history and an incremental sync stops once a page reaches the newest stored record.

Provides input, output, reasoning, cacheRead, cacheWrite5m, cacheWrite1h, provider, an optional API-key id and app, the billing source (free/byok/credit/…), and the Console-charged USD amount (cost_micro_cents / 1e8).
Missing: no session id — records carry the org id instead of a workspace id; free/BYOK usage is tagged via the billing source.
Cost: the Console-charged amount when present, otherwise estimated from the price table (or re-priced under unified pricing).
Needs a signed-in Console tab; auto-sync (opencode only) reuses an open Console tab, or opens a background one, every 6h.
A local DB import (tools/import-local.mjs) lands in localImportData and serves models the server no longer reports (e.g. free models).
